reuse.why: Extends the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard that all six link handlers already call first, instead of adding checks per handler.

duplication.why: The closed check is written once and shared by every provider's link path.

placement.why: Lives in the shared pre-link validation in accounts/app.ts, the right layer, though inside a helper whose name only describes the already-linked rule.

scope.why: Only the guard, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and central; the helper name assertBankAccountNotLinked no longer describes everything it checks, which is a mild readability cost.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every link*Account handler before any write
